exports: createLocalCollector({stateDir, fixture?, readOnly?, fault?, onDelivery?, responseFor?})
entry_point.persistence: Returned store is the existing LocalCollectionStore; all fixture lifecycle writes use its journal/object ports. Future evidence kinds require explicit scope/allowlist ownership amendment.

store.scope: Linux fixture-only OS lock, bounded content-addressed objects and whole-operation journal commits. No general PR011 kind is registered; do not duplicate this journal.

limitations: No exactly-once external request guarantee. An intent without verified response stays charged and terminal unresolved.
Broader research update-cycle and PDF orchestration are not integrated.
In-memory origin-governor token state is not durable; persisted fixture reservation and synthetic global ordinal bound recovery.
No live network, managed database/storage, paid inference, payload acquisition, publication or production activation.
